claim.claim-text: 1. A robotic catheter procedure system (10) for performing a procedure to treat a vascular lesion, comprising:

a first percutaneous device (84) extending through a lumen and out of a distal end of a second percutaneous device (60), the first percutaneous device (84) comprising an end section, the end section being helical (86) and structured to create a bore through the vascular lesion, the first percutaneous device (84) further comprising a control wire (120), and a control system (40) controlling a first actuating mechanism (50) configured to engage and to impart axial and rotational movement of the first percutaneous device (84), wherein the shape of the helical end section (86) of the first percutaneous device (84) is changeable to allow the user to control the ability of first percutaneous device (84) to bore through the vascular lesion, wherein a second actuating mechanism (52) causes movement of the second percutaneous device (60) to the bore created by the first percutaneous device (84), wherein the shape of the helical end section (86) of the first percutaneous device (84) is changeable via a third actuating mechanism.

2. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 1, further comprising a bedside system (12), the bedside system (12) comprising the first percutaneous device (84), the second percutaneous device (60) configured to engage and to impart movement to the second percutaneous device (60), the first actuating mechanism (50), and the second actuating mechanism (52).

3. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 2, further comprising a remote workstation (14), the remote workstation (14) comprising a user interface (30) and the control system (40) operatively coupled to the user interface and to the bedside system (12).
4. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 1, wherein the first percutaneous device (84) is a guide wire comprising the helical end section (86) with a helical shaped section.

5. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 4, wherein the helical shaped section includes a coil diameter and a coil angle, wherein at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle are adjustable during the procedure.

6. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 5, wherein the bedside system (12) includes the third actuating mechanism configured to adjust at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle of the helical shaped section.
7. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 6, wherein the guide wire (84) includes the control wire (120) and the third actuating mechanism engages the control wire (120).

8. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 7, wherein the control wire (120) has a distal end coupled to the end section of the guide wire (84) and a proximal end coupled to the third actuating mechanism, wherein the third actuating mechanism applies tension to the control wire (120) to adjust at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle during the procedure.
9. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 8, wherein both the coil diameter and the coil angle increase when the tension applied to the control wire (120) increases.

10. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 6, wherein the control system (40) controls the third actuating mechanism to adjust at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle during the procedure.

11. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 10, wherein the user interface (30) includes a control receiving a user input, wherein the third actuating mechanism causes adjustment of at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle in response to the user input.

12. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 11, wherein the control is associated with a specific coil diameter and coil angle, and further wherein the third actuating mechanism causes adjustment of the helical section to assume the specific coil diameter and coil angle associated with the control in response to the user input.

13. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 10, wherein the control system (40) controls the third actuating mechanism to adjust at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle based upon data related to the performance of the procedure.

14. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 13, wherein the data includes at least one of force experienced by the first percutaneous device (84) during traversal of the lesion and speed of the first percutaneous device (84) during traversal of the lesion.

15. The robotic catheter procedure system of claim 14, wherein at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle adjusted by the third actuating mechanism is inversely related to the force experienced by the first percutaneous device (84) during traversal of the lesion, wherein at least one of the coil diameter and coil angle adjusted by the third actuating mechanism is particularly directly related to the speed of the first percutaneous device (84) during traversal of the lesion.
